data.name: CNE1
data.detailed_description:
Crónicas de Nueva Estrella Uno

Nueva Estrella Uno is the last bastion of life as we know it—a floating city where Followers and Preceptors struggle for power and control. The inhabitants of the platform bow before you, Grand Mentor, chosen by the Intelligence to guide us back to the planet’s surface.

The player takes on the role of the Grand Mentor, a powerful figure who must make crucial decisions to manage, control, and ensure the well-being of Nueva Estrella Uno’s inhabitants. Alongside loyal Preceptors—Orn Kraftwerk, Anette Desrois, Iaia, Ignasus Rigidus, Druout Offerman, Marduk Abdullah, and Minister Atton—the Grand Mentor will receive a complete overview of the platform’s activities.

Decision-making, resource management, and the platform’s secrets are in your hands. At the end of each playthrough, the player receives a personality report reflecting the choices and actions taken throughout the game.

Immerse yourself in the universe of Chronicles of Nueva Estrella Uno and discover what kind of Grand Mentor you are!

  • Over 100 collectible secrets

  • More than 7 different endings

  • Every decision matters!

Navigate through the Holomap across the various locations the platform has to offer:

Features:

⦁ An intriguing futuristic universe awaits: uncover the secrets of Nueva Estrella Uno.
⦁ Your choices shape your journey; your decisions have consequences in the story and its multiple endings.
⦁ Player experience is defined by meaningful choices, resulting in different psychological player profiles.
